facts.fact: The PPPC, with the Ministry of Information and Digitalisation and MACRA, hosted a hybrid public stakeholder consultation in Lilongwe on the draft Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Regulations with private and public sector stakeholders, and invited written submissions by 6 March 2024.
